   Plan: REDACTED

   Context

   greet.js exports a single greet(name) helper via module.exports = { greet };. We want a matching farewell(name).

   Steps

   - Add function farewell(name) { return 'Goodbye, ' + name; } below greet in greet.js, matching its
     string-concatenation style.
   - Update the export to module.exports = { greet, farewell };.
   - Verify: node -e "console.log(require('./greet').farewell('Ada'))" should print Goodbye, Ada.

   Note

   Existing greet returns 'Helo, ' (typo). Out of scope; left unchanged unless you want it fixed.
